personal_info.summary: Full Stack Developer specialized in building robust, scalable, and user-centric applications across the entire development lifecycle. With hands-on experience in technologies like React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

responsibilities: Developed and maintained a critical educational platform used by 1,500+ institutions, 600,000+ students, and 150,000+ staff members.
Contributed to the management of 26 M+ monthly transactions (attendance, grades, tasks, logins).
Implemented end-to-end testing with Cypress and refactored legacy code for improved performance and maintainability.
Designed and delivered the 'Comedor Attendance' module, optimizing the data model for scalability.
Acted as a go-to developer for urgent or complex tasks within the team.
Led the development of a web platform for managing 78 sports clubs and 8,500 active players.
Built a full stack architecture with Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and production VPS deployment.
Delivered real-time views of fixtures, results, standings; and a backoffice for tournament management, payments, and statistics.
achievements: Received direct recognition from league leadership for usability and operational impact.

responsibilities: Built full stack solutions using React, Angular, Node.js, Laravel, and MySQL for regional and international projects.
Developed a mobile-first PWA for 15,000-20,000 monthly users across 3 countries.
Contributed to an international e-commerce platform with dynamic discounts and referral programs.
Led end-to-end development with pixel-perfect Figma implementation and high client satisfaction.
Automated key processes using JavaScript and SQL, reducing execution time from 4 h to 1 h.
Managed 9 active platforms across 3 countries and handled 10+ monthly Jira tickets.
Created operational reports with SQL and Excel, performed functional testing, and supported enterprise clients.
achievements: Helped the team earn 5/5 satisfaction scores in annual internal surveys.
